purpose: The clock-move gate (eval/reports/pricing_and_clock_v1.md, Part 3): fifteen questions whose right answer turns on today's date, the weekday, the time left, a day count or the gameweek state. Every expected fact below was computed from the FROZEN clock and the tools' own data on the laptop copy of the server dump of Fri 23 Oct 2026 19:54Z (run 51 = t10:GW8), never from an assumed truth; the scratchpad script time_facts.py made the reads with now_context.clock held at the frozen instant.
data_as_of: run 51 (t10:GW8) built 2026-10-23 17:21Z; availability as of 2026-10-23 17:21:24Z; GW7 last finished; GW8 in progress; next deadline GW9 Saturday 2026-10-31 11:00 UTC
must_say_rule: Each item is a list of alternative regular expressions (case-insensitive) matched against the reply; an item passes when any alternative matches; a question's must-say passes when every item passes. A failed item is a CANDIDATE time error only: it is confirmed by quoting the wrong phrase and the source line with the right value, and dismissed by quoting the source line that supports the answer (report Part 3, rule R1).
